bifrost: bifrost_app::pasteboard, bifrost_app::print, bifrost_app::workspace, bifrost_ui::geometry::Region, bifrost_ui::ax (Announcements, custom actions), springboard/src/shell/atspi/, springboard/src/shell/magnifier.rs
summary: Application Services is mostly legacy Carbon C API (Apple Event Manager, ColorSync, Speech Synthesis, PDEPlugIn, HIShape, Translation). BifrOSt covers the pasteboard, the accessibility tree (AT-SPI2 instead of AXUIElement), printing through CUPS, a rectangle-set region type for shapes, and an announcement queue with named custom actions in the element map; ColorSync, speech synthesis and the print-plug-in APIs have no counterpart, and the new accessibility models are not yet wired to the AT-SPI bridge.

features.note: Text, file URLs, png, html, rtf and uri-list through UTType ids and MIME mapping; only the text-like type reaches the Wayland selection, and no change count is exposed to the Apple name.

features.apple: Carbon Accessibility: AXUIElement.h, AXRoleConstants.h, AXAttributeConstants.h, AXNotificationConstants.h, AXActionConstants.h
features.note: AT-SPI2 bridge maps app node trees to roles, states and actions (Press, SetValue, Focus). Apps that send no tree appear as a flat list; shell chrome is not in the tree; the bridge is untested with a live Orca.

features.feature: Accessibility text (AXText, attributed strings, text markers)
features.note: No selected-text, visible-range, text-marker or caret events reach the accessibility bridge; rich text is not exposed as attributed strings.

features.apple: AXNotificationConstants.h (announcement requested notification, announcement key, priority key); NSAccessibilityCustomAction (name and handler)
features.note: The UI model queues announcements with polite and assertive priority, drops repeats and bounds the queue, and keeps named custom actions per element. The AT-SPI bridge does not read the queue or list the custom actions yet, so nothing is spoken and no custom action is invoked from assistive technology.
Shell magnifier with Original, Invert and Contrast filters. No app-facing API to read or set zoom focus.

features.apple: Core Printing: PMCreatePageFormat, PMCreatePrintSettings, PMCreateSession, PMGetAdjustedPageRect
features.note: Paper size, orientation, margins, copies and page range, submitted with lp; Save as PDF copies the file. No shell-drawn print sheet, no view pagination, and CUPS presence on the Midget image is unchecked.
No print panel plug-in mechanism; the print sheet is not shell-drawn yet.
PDF ICC-based images decode, but there is no profile or transform API and no display profile handling for apps.
No speech synthesis channel or voice API. Screen-reader output goes through Orca on AT-SPI, not through an SDK call.

features.feature: Apple Event Manager (AEDesc, Apple Event dispatch)
features.note: Carbon-era IPC with no BifrOSt counterpart. The control socket RPC and App Intents cover the same app-automation role, not the descriptor format.

Region is a set of disjoint rectangles with bounds, containment, area, translation and union, intersection, subtract and xor. Curved paths are not modelled, and no app-facing SDK wrapper exposes Region yet.
Legacy Carbon translation service for document conversion. Not applicable to BifrOSt.

gaps: Accessibility text: selected text, visible range, text markers and caret events are not exposed through the AT-SPI bridge.
Accessibility announcements: the queue exists in the UI model but the AT-SPI bridge does not speak it yet.
Custom accessibility actions: listed by the element map but not exposed to the bridge or invoked from assistive technology.
ColorSync: no profile, transform or CMM API for apps.
Speech synthesis: no SDK voice or speech channel API.
Core Printing: no shell-drawn print sheet, no view pagination, and no print panel plug-in mechanism.
HIShape: no curved paths and no SDK wrapper for the region type.
Universal Access: no app-facing zoom focus API.
